text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The day after our visit to the track,<n>I'm in the library
with Rob Roy<n>searching for useful info. Suddenly, I
remember the talk I had with her<n>instructor.
choice_data_list: Hey, you're entering the Tracen Meet, right?
Hey, you're entering the Tracen Meet, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Uh, yes! I'm surprised you<n>knew...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
To clear the confusion, I explain how<n>the topic came
up when I spoke with<n>her instructor.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Tracen Meet is a school-wide<n>race that takes
place on campus.<n>Some students focus on it as a
training goal.
choice_data_list: Good luck! I'll be there rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Right... Thank you... I guess...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I mean, it's not that I'm unhappy<n>you're
coming! I'm sorry, it's just<n>that... my running isn't
anything to<n>write about.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So... if you come to watch me race, I<n>might not even
stand out enough for<n>you to see me... That's how it
feels,<n>at least.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But if you spoke with my instructor...<n>then... you
must have heard. You<n>know how poorly I've been
performing.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I didn't mean to pry.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's not that! I'm grateful for your<n>concern about
me. And I can't deny<n>that my lack of progress has
been<n>troubling me a little... Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I... I've never had any merits in<n>particular. All I really
enjoy is reading,<n>and I've always been... incredibly
plain.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I've gotten used to<n>blending into the
background. So<n>when someone does try to pay me
attention, it makes me...<n>self-conscious.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I end up thinking "I have to make sure<n>I don't
embarrass myself!" I'm sure<n>I'd try with all my
might... until I wind<n>up injuring myself again.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
When I compare myself to the heroes<n>in my books,
who attract attention as<n>naturally as breathing... the
difference<n>is so stark, all I can do is laugh.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's pathetic... I don't live up to my<n>name one bit.
choice_data_list: Your name?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes... Um, let me show you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She moves to a nearby shelf and,<n>without searching
for even a moment,<n>pulls out a certain book.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy... That's this book's title. Ishare the name of the hero this novelis about.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's the story of a classic folk hero. A<n>brave and
honorable soul who fights<n>the strong to protect the
weak. Ahh... I<n>couldn't be more different.
choice_data_list: Rob Roy...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... ha... I'm sorry... I think I need<n>to go home
now!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I try to chase after her, but of course,<n>I don't stand
much chance of<n>catching up with an Umamusume.
Just like that, she's already gone...
choice_data_list: (Hm, if I were her, where would I head?)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A certain place comes to mind after a<n>moment's
thought. Strangely<n>confident about her location, I set
out<n>running.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The training grounds... As I arrive, I<n>spot a lone
figure watching the track<n>from a distance. I knew
she'd be<n>here.
choice_data_list: Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hm? Wha? Trainer?! How did you<n>find me?
choice_data_list: I didn't think you'd go straight home after that.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But surely that would be the most<n>natural place to
go!
choice_data_list: No way. You're not one to give up easily.
No way. You're not one to give up easily.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I take out the notebook I found<n>yesterday. It shows
the trajectory of<n>her struggles—every trial and error.
It's proof that Rob Roy is unable to<n>give up.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's... Wait, don't tell me... you<n>looked inside?
choice_data_list: Well... I had to find its owner, so...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... ahaha... I must look like a fool.<n>Acting like I'd
given up, when I was<n>writing all that in my
notebook.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
As if it would ever amount to<n>anything... I'm sorry
you had to see<n>that. Please just... throw it in the
garbage or something.
choice_data_list: I'm not going to throw this away.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh... R-right, of course not, sorry. Here,<n>I'll get rid of
it myself.
choice_data_list: I just need to make sure.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Of... what?
choice_data_list: Rob Roy... what's your dream?
Rob Roy... what's your dream?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ahh! Uh... Well, I... You... you won't<n>laugh?
choice_data_list: I won't laugh. I promise.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
What I... What I really want... What<n>I've always
wanted... is to be a hero.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She speaks as if she's telling me her<n>darkest
secret, and yet also revealing<n>a delicate treasure.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I, uh, haven't debuted yet... and I<n>have no results to
show. I don't have<n>a single person watching my
progress...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But even considering all that... I still<n>want to cling to
my dream of<n>becoming a hero.
choice_data_list: That's a great dream.
That's a great dream.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It is?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Everything she's done, from joining<n>my hero hunt,
to meticulously<n>observing her peers training, to
running away to this specific place...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It all shows that Zenno Rob Roy has<n>never given up
on her dream of<n>becoming a hero.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But... it isn't. It's a terrible and<n>completely ludicrous
dream.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: There are plenty of otherstudents—whether among my peers,seniors, or juniors—who are actually great enough to deserve being calleda hero.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And they each have their own<n>amazing dreams that
they carry in<n>their stories... like protecting their
family's pride, or bringing joy to all<n>who watch
them!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I don't have a dream like that. All I<n>want is to stand
out a little, for people<n>to notice me!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But I don't have a story! I'll never be<n>anything
more than a supporting<n>character!
choice_data_list: ...But you still want to become a hero, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!
choice_data_list: Let me use your notebook for a sec.
Let me use your notebook for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Wh-why?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I take out a marker from my bag, but I<n>don't open
the notebook. All I need is<n>the cover.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, uh, what are you doing with it?<n>Hey...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It only takes a moment, and I'm done.<n>I turn back to
Rob Roy... and hand her<n>what used to be her
notebook.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "The Chronicle of Zenno Rob Roy"...
choice_data_list: That's the story I want to read!
That's the story I want to read!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Wha... What?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing more certain than an<n>undying
dream. As long as she keeps<n>trying, I'm sure it will
come true... No,<n>I'll make it come true.
choice_data_list: I want to help with your training.
I want to help with your training.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But... I'm so weak and untalented... I<n>might let down
your hopes. Are you...<n>absolutely certain?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I give her a confident nod. The searchfor my hero is off for now. What Iwant to find out next is how her storyunfolds.
